title: Starting a MinION Sequencing Run Using MinKNOW
author: Josh Quick
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7q6hmze

steps.title: Connect MinION Hardware
steps.instruction: Plug the MinION into the computer and wait for the MinION and flowcell to be detected.

steps.title: Initiate New Experiment
steps.instruction: Click the 'New Experiment' button located in the bottom left of the screen.

steps.title: Configure Run Parameters
steps.instruction: Set the experiment parameters in the New experiment popup screen across the individual tabs and click 'Start run'.

substeps.instruction: Experiment: Name the run in the experiment field and leave the sample field blank.
Kit: Select LSK109 (as there is no option for native barcoding NBD104).
Run Options: Set the run length to 6 hours (note: run can be stopped once sufficient data is collected as determined by RAMPART).
Basecalling: Keep basecalling turned on and select 'fast basecalling'.
Output: Set the number of files MinKNOW writes to a single folder (default is 4000; can be reduced for more frequent RAMPART updates).

steps.title: Monitor Sequencing Progress
steps.instruction: Use the MinKNOW interface to monitor the progress of the run.
